item.title: Let's Encrypt is adding two additional remote perspectives for domain validation
item.description:
📝 Phil October 15, 2026, 2:14pm 1 Hey everybody, Let's Encrypt is adding two new remote perspectives for domain validation. During domain validation, this means that we will make seven total validation requests, one from the primary datacenter and six from remote perspectives (previously four). Let's Encrypt will begin performing domain validation with the new regions in staging on Tuesday, October 27th, 2026.
🔗 Read more: https://community.letsencrypt.org/t/lets-encrypt-is-adding-two-additional-remote-perspectives-for-domain-validation/252166

item.title: ESA's Hera Will View Asteroid Scars from DART's Strike
item.description:
📝 AerospaceNews Hera Mission Prepares for Follow-Up Asteroid Imaging The ESA spacecraft will capture results of a planetary defense testDavid Dickinson22h2 min readDavid Dickinson is a freelance science writer and long-time sky watcher. A rendering of Hera shows the spacecraft approaching the Dimorphos asteroid, with a portion of the larger Didymos asteroid on the left. In November and December, Hera will acquire baseline measurements of the asteroids from 25 to 30 kilometers away.
🔗 Read more: https://spectrum.ieee.org/esa-hera-dimorphos-rendezvous
